name: Slerp per pixel across channels
plain: Each pixel's channel vector gets its own angle, the same axis bislerp uses, but with no magnitude lerp afterward. Different pixels rotate by different amounts. Catalogued as a short entry; see the RES4LYF tribute page.
math: dim is the channel axis. Sine weights multiply raw low and high; near or opposite (|dot|>0.9995) falls back to lerp.
